title: MOTION (JUURADO - BLUMENFIELD) and RESOLUTION relative to issuing bonds in an amount not to exceed $17,000,000 to finance the new construction of the…
text:
[Council File 26-1593; CD 14]
[Items Noticed for Public Hearing]
MOTION (JUURADO - BLUMENFIELD) and RESOLUTION relative to issuing bonds in an amount not to exceed $17,000,000 to finance the new construction of the 190-space parking located at 755 South Los Angeles Street in Council District 14.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. HOLD a Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act of 1982 (TEFRA) public hearing at the City Council Meeting to be held on November 13, 2026.
2. ADOPT the accompanying TEFRA RESOLUTION approving the issuance of bonds in an amount not to exceed $17,000,000 for the new construction of a 190- space parking lot located at 755 South Los Angeles Street in Council District 14.
summary: Council would adopt a TEFRA resolution approving up to $17 million in bonds to build a 190-space parking lot at 755 South Los Angeles Street.
